name_destination.description: name_destination is the resolved destination address of the NFT class root name

class_id.description: class_id is the identifier of the NFT class to update

always_listed.description: always_listed determines if NFTs in this class should always be listed for sale and override the listed status of the individual NFTs

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgSetNFTCl.title: Msg Set NFT Class Always Listed
dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgSetNFTCl.description: MsgSetNFTClassAlwaysListed sets the always_listed flag for an NFT class. Only the owner of the NFT class root name can update this setting.

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgSetNFTCl.title: Msg Set NFT Class Always Listed Response
dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgSetNFTCl.description: MsgSetNFTClassAlwaysListedResponse defines the response for MsgSetNFTClassAlwaysListed
